title: The continuum spectrum of nonrelativistic multi-frequency Proca stars
summary: Multi-frequency Proca stars are excited selfgravitating solutions of the $s=1$ Schrödinger-Poisson system that generalize the conventional stationary states of a massive vector field. Unlike stationary states, which are characterized by a single oscillation frequency, multi-frequency configurations exhibit a quasi-periodic dynamics involving two or three distinct frequencies.
